newsitems.title: Bungie unvaulting Destiny 2 content was a studio-saving emergency decision, because Marathon updates were never going to be enough
newsitems.author: Samuel Roberts
newsitems.contents: Over the past couple of months, my Destiny 2 Fireteam has given me a tour of the Destiny 2 content I missed when I hopped off the train following the pandemic. When you play all the dungeons back-to-back, it's a buffet of delights—a concentrated dose of amazing and frequently obtuse FPS level design that you simply can't find anywhere else. A reminder that Bungie, pre-layoffs, was the very best at what it did... Read more.

newsitems.title: Официально: Bungie возобновит поддержку Destiny 2 и вернёт весь удалённый контент
newsitems.author: Вадим Съедин
newsitems.contents: Bungie объявила о решении возобновить поддержку Destiny 2. Как пояснил новый лидер студии Порья Торкан, за последние несколько лет Bungie лишилась доверия со стороны аудитории и потеряла ценных специалистов. Сейчас она намерена трансформироваться.

newsitems.title: Bungie un-cancels Destiny: Vaulted content is coming back as new leadership promises 'Destiny is foundational to our future'
newsitems.author: Morgan Park
newsitems.contents: Bungie's new leadership duo laid out the "next chapter of Bungie" today in a blog post with an accompanying video. The big news is that Bungie has essentially uncanceled Destiny 2, or will at least go the lengths to finally undo its greatest mistake: vaulting a bunch of raids and multiple of its story campaigns. Funnily enough, that work has already begun on the community side with a mod project that makes vaulted content playable through an offline build of Destiny... Read more.

newsitems.title: Destiny возвращается после отмены поддержки благодаря фанатам - Bungie вернёт вырезанный контент и готовит новые игры
newsitems.contents:
Bungie неожиданно пересмотрела планы по развитию Destiny 2. Всего через несколько месяцев после заявления о прекращении выпуска нового контента студия объявила о возвращении ранее удалённых материалов и подтвердила, что у вселенной Destiny есть будущее за пределами текущей игры.

Главной частью заявления стало возвращение контента, который начал исчезать из Destiny 2 ещё в 2020 году. Bungie планирует вернуть кампании и локации Red War и Forsaken, а также более ранние дополнения Curse of Osiris и Warmind. Подробности о сроках и формате возвращения разработчики обещают раскрыть позднее.

Удаление старого контента на протяжении многих лет оставалось одной из наиболее спорных особенностей Destiny 2. В результате новые игроки фактически получали игру без значительной части её первоначальной истории, тогда как владельцы ранее доступных дополнений лишались возможности снова пройти некоторые из них. Возвращение этих материалов должно сделать Destiny 2 более цельной с точки зрения контента и упростить знакомство с многолетней историей серии.

При этом Bungie дала понять, что речь идёт не только о Destiny 2. В новом заявлении студия подтвердила планы на новые истории и новые игры во вселенной Destiny. Конкретных названий и сроков пока нет, поэтому говорить о Destiny 3 преждевременно. Marathon также продолжит развиваться, но Bungie не рассматривает его как замену Destiny.

По словам студии, одним из факторов пересмотра стратегии стала реакция сообщества. Особенно показательной оказалась аудитория финального обновления «Монумент Триумфа»: несмотря на отсутствие нового контента, оно собрало больше игроков, чем два предыдущих дополнения. Это стало важным сигналом о сохраняющемся интересе к Destiny 2 и самой франшизе.

При этом возвращение к активному развитию не произойдёт мгновенно. Поддержка была остановлена относительно недавно, поэтому Bungie потребуется время для восстановления процессов и определения дальнейших планов. В ближайшие месяцы студия обещает рассказать больше о функциях, сроках и будущем Destiny 2.

Таким образом, история Destiny 2 получила неожиданный поворот. Игра, которую ещё недавно готовили к фактическому завершению развития, не только возвращает значительную часть своего прошлого контента, но и получает перспективу дальнейшего существования вместе с новыми проектами во вселенной Destiny.

newsitems.title: Создатель Counter-Strike объяснил исчезновение классического режима со спасением заложников из-за киберспорта
newsitems.contents:
Соавтор оригинальной Counter-Strike Мин Ли рассказал о причинах постепенного заката классического режима со спасением заложников, который стоял у истоков культовой франшизы. В рамках интервью независимому блогеру разработчик отметил, что стремительное развитие соревновательной сцены вынесло приговор сценариям с префиксом cs_, сместив весь фокус компании Valve и игрового сообщества на разминирование бомбы.

Изначальная концепция командного шутера в 1999 году строилась именно вокруг спецопераций по освобождению пленных, вдохновленных тактическим проектом Rainbow Six и реальными операциями отряда специального назначения SAS вроде штурма захваченного террористами посольства в Лондоне. Первые бета-версии сетевого боевика обрели популярность именно благодаря локациям cs_siege и cs_assault, где бойцы спецназа были обязаны штурмовать укрепленные позиции противника.

Главным изъяном сценариев с заложниками разработчик назвал структурный дисбаланс, который не поддается выравниванию. В отличие от карт с закладкой взрывчатки, где 2 стороны борются за контроль над нейтральными точками, локации по спасению пленных изначально дают огромное позиционное преимущество обороняющимся террористам. Попытки адаптировать эти уровни под равное состязание регулярно терпели крах, поскольку штурмующей команде приходится преодолевать узкие коридоры под перекрестным огнем без возможности гибкого тактического маневра.

С ростом профессиональной киберспортивной сцены компания Valve сосредоточила усилия на сценариях обезвреживания бомбы, где строгая геометрия и симметрия таймингов обеспечили понятный спортивный регламент. По воспоминаниям Мина Ли, создатели игры всегда проявляли предельную осторожность в отношении базовых механик, опасаясь отпугнуть профессиональных игроков и турнирных операторов непредсказуемыми условиями матчей.

Ориентация индустрии на турниры повлекла за собой охлаждение интереса со стороны авторов пользовательских модификаций. Картоделы быстро перестали создавать локации с заложниками, поскольку игроки не проявляли к ним интереса и предпочитали тренироваться на соревновательных полигонах вроде de_dust2. В результате классический режим полностью исчез из турнирного пула, превратившись в нишевую забаву для случайных матчей на казуальных серверах.

Несмотря на наличие обновленных карт cs_office и cs_italy в актуальной версии Counter-Strike 2, соревновательный базис игры окончательно закрепился за сценариями с деактивацией взрывчатки, оставив исторический режим в статусе ретро-развлечения.

Good luck to you brave mercenaries on battling Gray Mann's toughest war, and best of all this event has no deadline!

newsitems.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone - Season 06 - Now Live
newsitems.author: RedBruto
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/576f539228171212688a34e304f59274605f6557.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Outlast the Unknown: Black Ops Season 06 is Here![/h2][p][/p][h3]The Haunting[/h3][p]The Haunting returns and there’s nowhere to hide! Season 06 is brimming with evil as fright-filled maps and modes arrive as part of a colossal update that will satisfy your sweet tooth to Halloween and beyond. [/p][p][/p][h3]Season 06 Roadmap[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/53793f7b90276244fa77960d27c24cb7bce6ce93.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Across [i]Call of Duty® Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone[/i]™, Season 06 amps up the scares with Haunted Hollow, where cosmic horrors and a Ghost Train infiltrate the small-town Resurgence map. In Multiplayer, rack up the kills in the Quantum and Bloodstead maps, Hordepoint mode, and face off on Zombies locations in MP during T.E.D.D. Trials. Conjure a terrifying foe in Endgame’s Forbidden Summoning Event as night descends upon Avalon and face off against pumpkin-headed hordes in Zombies across a slew of grisly new content. [/p][p]Brave the horrors with an assortment of new Base Weapons earned in the Battle Pass and through in-game events, including the TR51 Para Assault Rifle, the iconic VMP SMG, Arcblade Melee Weapon, and Roc 20mm Special Weapon. Unlock new Attachments through Weekly Challenges, summon the forces of Hell with a DOOM-themed Event and Bundle, and much more.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Join in for a frightfully good time when Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Season 06 launches on September 17 at 9AM PT.[/p][p][/p][h2]Black Ops 7: Endgame Content[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Night Falls on Avalon:[/b] The Haunting brings nightfall to Endgame’s Avalon, changing up the gameplay experience as Operators take on Activities and Assignments after dark.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New World Event:[/b] A new guest has arrived with The Haunting. Call upon the darkness in the Forbidden Summoning Event.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Avalon Night (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c11d81bb55b125f5bb2368d5964d9a82c4b50aed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Endgame, night descends on Avalon, plunging Operators into an eerie landscape where Fears, Guild opponents, and other obstacles seek to eliminate squads under the cover of night.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Forbidden Summoning Event (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2574071cdc1074a813fe495600e29f6b8c540f20.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Avalon has a new guest courtesy of The Haunting. Unlock the seals to free an ancient threat in the Forbidden Summoning Event and bring plenty of backup to receive its worthy rewards.[/p][p][/p][h2]Black Ops 7: Multiplayer Content[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] Breach an Arctic computing facility in the frigid Quantum, encounter unexplainable horrors in Bloodstead, and drop into Zombies-themed maps Roadkill, Lost, and Inferno for the competitive T.E.D.D. Trials.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Limited-Time Modes:[/b] In T.E.D.D. Trials, victory goes to the team who completes the most tasks, featuring 6v6 matchups across three Zombies maps. In Hordepoint, control the objective to turn the undead against your foes, and immobilize the enemy in Freeze Tag.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Black Ops 7 Ranked Play:[/b] Get wins and climb the Ranks in the next season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, including new seasonal rewards.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Quantum (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9d34343ee2f5a7fb2e0f25b1f04a572842c704d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Seize upon a Guild quantum computing facility buried within the Arctic ice before its secrets are lost. In this narrow map, Operators must brave the cold and snow across the facility’s frigid outdoor spaces including the Courtyard, Square, and Catwalk, while the map’s interior spaces bring combat to a fever pitch in tight areas like the Servers, Maintenance, Hallway, and the frozen Turbine. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7c899e0ec45a73fad051755b475fc2e594a9e33b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Damage inflicted on the structure has revealed new routes and cover, including openings in the roof of the central Tower, giving room for aerial streaks to find their way in. The Tower draws attention with a dangerous play space marked with dense cover, openings on all four sides, and a concealed flanking path in the center. Using speed and precision, work with your teammates to calculate a winning score.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bloodstead (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Retheme, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a37e2b758ebde67f087dd00dc46a7ae51e8a978d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight through a forsaken Homestead as an unexplained horror descends on the Mason home. The waters have turned to blood, zombies lurk around the perimeter, and blood trails mark every corner of the map.[/p][p]A body hangs from the rafters in the Corpse House and the Blood Shed, while gore overflows in the Cyst Lodge kitchen. Upstairs, a watchful eye looks over the chaos within. Everywhere you look, horror awaits; tread carefully or risk losing your sanity before the fight is won.[/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Limited-Time Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]T.E.D.D. Trials (Launch, LTM)[/b][/p][p][i]New LTM, Zombies Maps Only[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2c3634c8ef9aa73283a7bb4e906783a8118a943c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Compete in 6v6 across a variety of T.E.D.D. Trials in this special playlist bringing three iconic Zombies maps into Multiplayer for the first time in Black Ops 7. Fight off the enemy team and wield Ray Guns against the horde as a random set of five T.E.D.D. Trials cycles through rotation! The first team to reach the Score Limit or have the most score by the time limit wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Roadkill[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cf24f35555c337866913b157446877bb45e84ae0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Take on trials by Reba’s Diner in Roadkill, based on the Exit 115 location from Ashes of the Damned.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Inferno[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b72901434bd61efd846bf3552580543646653352.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Brave the heat in the ancestral castle from Kowakujō. Complete trials on this map surrounded by active volcanoes and flowing lava rivers.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lost[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6d974ae0d793ab5ee26e2c98743faeef116cc41.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Deploy to the remote Eidskallen Lighthouse from Totenreich. Traverse the frigid island and fight to be the first team through each trial![/p][p][/p][p][b]Hordepoint (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning LTM, 6v6[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0b0ad058d1e768f6e25d253cf252e4fb84b3afd3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Control and hold the objective to score and to turn the horde against the enemy team. In this terrifying twist on Hardpoint, zombies roam the map, lunging at nearby Operators. When the Hardpoint is neutral, they will attack both teams. When one team controls the objective, the zombies will join them and only attack the opposing team, making Hardpoint control critical to winning the match.[/p][p]Check their eyes if you’re unsure of their current allegiance: red-eyed zombies will attack you on sight, while blue eyes signify that the undead are fighting on your side. Keep a sharp eye on the Hardpoint rotation, because the switch can happen in an instant. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Freeze Tag (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning LTM[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Drop into a 6v6 respawn mode where teams compete to freeze the enemy while keeping their allies in the fight. Downed targets will drop and become encased in ice; only their teammates can free them by damaging the ice. Freeze the entire enemy team for a bonus. Proximity chat is enabled. [/p][p][/p][p]Black Ops 7 Moshpit and More[/p][p]Keep an eye out for additional playlists. including the Black Ops 7 Appreciation Moshpit, featuring a mix of Face Off and Core game modes across top-voted maps from throughout the past year.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 06 Multiplayer Ranked Play (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0da2f876d9308ed72109bb62bf28ec85cd0eca19.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Season 06 Ranked Play Overview[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Multiplayer Ranked Play gives players the ultimate competitive experience by offering the same settings, maps, modes, and weapon restrictions used by the Call of Duty® League™. [/p][p]Earn career rewards throughout the lifespan of Black Ops 7 Multiplayer Ranked Play, including Rank Skins and Win Challenge rewards.[/p][p]Note: Season 06 features a shortened run time for Multiplayer Ranked Play. Check in-game for more info.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Season 06 Ranked Play Rewards[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a00ac3040f6960aaf8aa7e0ffcec0ce4aa8b9f31.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Get 5 Wins: Pro Re-Issue M15 Mod 0 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Get 50 Wins: “Ranked Season 06 — 100 Wins” Large Decal[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reach Silver Rank: “Ranked Season 06 — Silver” Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reach Gold Rank: “Ranked Season 06 — Gold” Calling Card and Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reach Platinum Rank: “Ranked Season 06 — Platinum” Calling Card and Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reach Diamond Rank: “Ranked Season 06 — Diamond” Calling Card and Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reach Crimson Rank: “Ranked Season 06 — Crimson” Calling Card and Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reach Iridescent Rank: “Ranked Season 06 — Iridescent” Animated Calling Card and Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Finish Season 06 at the Top 250 Rank: “Ranked Season 06 —Top 250” Animated Calling Card and Animated Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Finish Season 06 at the Top 250 #1 Overall: “Ranked Season 06 — Top 250 Champion” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7: Zombies [/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Survival Map:[/b] The undead have overrun the Masaki family’s ancestral castle in the Tenshu Survival map. Rally your squad, fight to survive in Kowakujō's central keep, and reach round milestones to earn rewards. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Rex Infernus Directed Mode, Starting Room:[/b] Directed Mode arrives for Rex Infernus, giving players extra guidance when tackling the Main Quest. In Starting Room, see how far you can get without leaving the House. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Major Rogue Run Update:[/b] Get new pedestal rewards in Rogue Run including Pack-a-Punch IV, an Ultra-Rarity weapon upgrade, and Golden Armor. Plus, drop into Casual and Hardcore playlists featuring Paradox Junction and Kowakujō.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Super Easter Egg:[/b] Players who have completed every Main Quest across all of Black Ops 7’s Round-Based Zombies Maps are in for a new surprise and fresh rewards...[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Survival Map: Tenshu (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aa631c243775619d41c178d1571f3a77c61fcd78.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Battle shambling samurai in Tenshu, a new Survival map challenging the crew to fight off the horde in a confined section of Kowakujō based around key areas like the Tenshu Entrance, Onsen Baths, War Room, Storage Rooms, and Workshop. [/p][p]Face Hellhounds, Oni, and the undead while scavenging for Perks, the Mystery Box, Arsenal, Wall Buys, GobbleGum Machine, and other upgrades. Survive as long as you can or Exfil to get out. [/p][p]Reach round milestones to earn the following rewards:[/p][list][*][p]“Mononoke Neko” Animated Emblem and 1,000 XP (complete Round 10)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Sleepy Cat” Weapon Charm and 2,500 XP (complete Round 25)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Wonderbar!” GobbleGum and 5,000 XP (complete Round 50)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Directed Mode: Rex Infernus (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/575199e3841b34b285e71418f3365249bf589acd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get some extra guidance for the Main Quest with the arrival of Directed Mode on Rex Infernus, providing on-screen quest steps and a max round cap of 15.[/p][p]Take on the Warden to avert universal destruction in the final Round-Based Zombies map for Black Ops 7. Face Deathspinners and the Web Mother as well as other threats as the crew crashes down into the Warden’s stronghold, smash enemies into the dust with the new Titan Trap and wield the Warden’s Blight Wonder Weapon.[/p][p]Players who complete Rex Infernus on Directed Mode will earn the “Netherclaw” Warden’s Blight Wonder Weapon Skin, “Rex Infernus Directed Mode Completion” Calling Card, and 5,000 XP.[/p][p][/p][h3]Starting Room: Rex Infernus (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d9d055159c0e0241fb3fc86c7b9b10bdbac9f253.jpg"][/img][/p][p]How long can you last? Make your stand in only the starting House with limited resources on hand. Traverse the two-story building, fighting back the undead in the upstairs bedrooms and around the downstairs fireplace and dining room. Use the following map items to further increase the temperature in this already scorching environment:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Rex Infernus:[/b] Mystery Box, Wall Buy (Warden 308), Wall Buy (Coda 9), Quick Revive, GobbleGum Machine[/p][p]Survive as long as you can to earn the following rewards:[/p][list][*][p]“Round Off” GobbleGum and 1,000 XP (reach Round 10)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Armor Gettin’” GobbleGum and 2,500 XP (reach Round 20)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Fully Packed” GobbleGum and 5,000 XP (reach Round 30)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Rogue Run Updates (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a4981b9714bacc7f5a68e6265fa19184eb35a645.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Challenge yourself and your crew in an expanded Rogue Run with the arrival of three new pedestal rewards, alongside the addition of Casual and Hardcore playlists for Paradox Junction and Kowakujō.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Pedestal Upgrades[/b][/p][p]As your Relic Tier increases, three powerful additions to the pedestal rewards will help you push into further rounds, including Pack-a-Punch Tier IV, an Ultra-Rarity weapon upgrade, and the coveted Golden Armor, featuring amor plates that automatically [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Returning Limited-Time Mode:[/b] Join a 64-player match of Giant Infected. Get details on SR tuning this season with more info arriving in the Season 06 patch notes.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Welcome to Haunted Hollow (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/45cfdcf869dda1588d9bb5f3ae19d12bec1e2bf2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Something evil has taken hold of Haven’s Hollow, twisting familiar locations into haunting new discoveries. Uncover sinister changes throughout the town, from the entangled River Boat to the raging fire at the Lumbermill and the Mansion gravity vortex. Cosmic tentacles dominate the skyline, heralding the arrival of unknown eldritch horrors, while evidence of occult activity plagues the darkened landscape.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0c69a1da7ea2c5120ac9fcf3ad5308cf2e29444e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Deploy to the haunted map in Operation Grave Rot to explore the once peaceful town, now transformed by Halloween and the creatures from beyond.[/p][p][/p][p][b]All Aboard the Ghost Train[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a57b23a6eb5abe611d64f048dd3ec800cb3dabc3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To get the goods on the Ghost Train traveling through Haunted Hollow, you’ll first need to find a way to phase the train back into reality. Use your time wisely to reach Supply Boxes, a Buy Station, Mystery Box, and other useful resources before the train returns to its immaterial form. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c85f03e8646ca09852c399274357be1a5c90ff93.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Trick or Treat Pumpkins[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/89bff92b32dcfab312bbb5442d5a4505089a91f7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The shops around town have left out festive pumpkins brimming with potential rewards, inviting Operator to take a chance on acquiring valuable loot at the risk of incurring the danger of a trick instead. Rewards include Zombies powerups that grant short-term buffs similar to Perks when activated.[/p][p][/p][p][b]And Other Surprises…[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c84fd25f48c7950ddd9b50e9935e21813c60bf6d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Haunting has taken over all of Haven's Hollow. From the gravity defying vortex in the Mansion foyer, to the burning of Lumbermill, to the drained Pond with its exposed eldritch sigils, to the massacre at the Research facility, there's so much to explore, offering new means of traversal, secrets to uncover, and even dark whispers of an ancient ritual on the brink of completion.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Limited-Time Mode (Launch)[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Giant Infected (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]64 Players, Haunted Hollow[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/010a0bc4ffd654590d84924a46cf88d1c275e429.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It’s Survivors vs. Infected on a grand scale in Giant Infected as 64 players descend on Haunted Hollow. Eight random players will be assigned as Infected from the start with the goal of infecting every player in the match while the Survivors fight to construct a DNA Bomb capable of stopping the outbreak in its tracks.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Survivors[/b][/p][p]Before matters escalate further than they already have, the survivors must gather DNA samples around the map to build and arm a DNA Bomb that will stop the outbreak.[/p][p]Each Survivor enters the match with a fixed Loadout that can be upgraded multiple times as they earn score from surviving, defeating enemies, collecting DNA samples, and completing activities. Collect enough DNA samples to initiate the bomb sequence. If it detonates, the Survivors win.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Infected[/b][/p][p]Fallen Survivors who are not revived in time will join the Infected team as a zombie with default abilities including unlimited sprint, special melee attacks, fast mantling, wall jumps, and no fall damage.[/p][p]The longer an Infected player survives, the stronger they’ll get, gaining increasing levels of strength via upgrades including faster movement speed, increased health, and access to a super jump. Eliminate Survivors and collect DNA to power up more quickly.[/p][p]Relentlessly pursue the Survivors, keep them from collecting DNA, and should they activate a DNA bomb, work with your fellow horde to shut it down and win the match. [/p][p][/p][h3]New Winstreak Challenges (Launch)[/h3][p]Earn Universal Weapon Camos by completing the required number of Victory Streaks over the course of a season across Battle Royale and Resurgence, as follows:[/p][p][/p][p]Battle Royale[/p][list][*][p]Win 10 Consecutive Matches: “Eye of the Storm” Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Win 25 Consecutive Matches: “Stormfront” Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][p]Resurgence[/p][list][*][p]Win 30 Consecutive Matches: “Harvest Haunt” Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Win 50 Consecutive Matches: “Neon Nightmare” Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][p]Black Ops Royale[/p][list][*][p]Win 10 Consecutive Matches: “Crimson Omen” Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Win 25 Consecutive Matches: “Contagion” Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][p]Note: Season 06 will be your last chance to play Black Ops Royale. Get those wins in and earn your Weapon Camos before the end of Season 06![/p][p][/p][h3]Season 06 Resurgence Ranked Play (Launch Window)[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Ranked Play Playlist Maps[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f70a38b338c4e451c918e3f7ca4d5e91590737e4.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Available Maps:[/b] Rebirth Island, Fortune’s Keep, Haven’s Hollow[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Season 06 Ranked Play Overview[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Climb the ranks in Season 06 Resurgence Ranked Play, giving players the ultimate competitive experience by offering the same settings and weapon restrictions used by the Call of Duty® League™. Note that Season 06 features a shortened run time for Resurgence Ranked Play. Check in-game for more info.[/p][p]We’re taking a close look at SR progression in Diamond+ tiers during Season 06. newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/193ccc95a4db1046f786363aa1e8849a76d3821b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]A Darker, More Dangerous Campaign[/h2][p][/p][p]Price is on the run, conflict has erupted on the Korean Peninsula, and a catastrophic weapon of war is on the verge of falling into the wrong hands. The October 23 launch date is fast approaching for [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i], with Campaign Early Access* going live on October 16 for those who pre-order the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game.[/p][p]Watch the official Campaign Trailer that debuted at the Tokyo Games Show for a deeper look at the elements in play. The global stakes have never been higher, and one wrong move could result in disastrous consequences for the entire world as we know it. This is [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="yLFRQaQT0qM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Captain Price on the Run[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/716e9bcaa8321b726bc858f896b8afdff873e3a6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]“There is a line… and it’s one we don’t cross.”[/i] — Kyle “Gaz” Garrick[/p][p][i]“We draw the line wherever we need it, don’t we?”[/i] — John Price[/p][p][/p][p]Following the assassination of General Shepherd in [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III[/i], Task Force 141 has been disbanded when its leader, John Price, goes on the run. There’s a growing conflict between the remnants of 141, as Ghost questions Price’s unlawful methods. Was Price right to take the law into his own hands, or has he betrayed everything he once stood for? Regardless, there’s a target on his back as Ghost and Gaz are tasked to capture or kill their former captain.[/p][p]Not everyone has turned against him, however, as CIA Station Chief Kate Laswell remains in touch with the operator-turned-outlaw — though even she may be growing wary of Price’s methods.[/p][p][/p][h3]Unlikely Allies[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ca62688e92ca729e690c4233cf038b56a83426c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]“Why sit on the high ground and watch the world burn when we can fight fire with fire?”[/i] — Valeria Garza[/p][p][/p][p]As former allies become foes, Price is forced to find help where he can get it. Enter El Sin Nombre AKA Valeria Garza, the leader of the Las Almas Cartel. She’s hardly the colleague Price would prefer to work with, but old rivalries must be dropped in the desperate need to tackle the greater threat that now faces them.[/p][p][/p][h3]A Peninsula in Turmoil[/h3][p][i]“Shut down the peninsula, then we invade.”[/i] — Commander Ri Ju-Young[/p][p][/p][p]North Korea has launched a full-scale invasion of South Korea, and Private Park Hyun Jun and his squad are forced to fight back to save their country. The joint US/ROK marines engage in ground combat, and an amphibious assault in a desperate fight for survival. [/p][p][/p][h3]A Weapon of War[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a89cfcc21370ff50ae3b837bb795cde064f3d02f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]“You are moving a weapon of war. What do you think happens when that weapon gets to the Archer?”[/i] — Kate Laswell[/p][p][/p][p]In parallel with the Korean invasion and the ongoing manhunt for Price lies an even greater threat. An unknown weapon of war is being delivered to a dangerous enemy known only as “The Archer.” What’s the weapon capable of, and what are the Archer’s motives in acquiring it? [/p][p]You won’t have long to wait to find out…[/p][p][/p][h2]The Story So Far[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/344cb5cc1a76baddb507439552d7b2039a79ba68.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Need a refresher on the major narrative beats leading up to this point? Check out our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/719041721925633150"]Story So Far recap[/url] of the prior three Modern Warfare games to get up to speed on the primary narrative elements at play.[/p][p][/p][h3]Campaign Early Access Begins October 16[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/afd5a861579a7baeed7683c7a98f19b327b62d8a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Starting on Friday, October 16, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] get Early Access* to the game’s Campaign.[/p][p]This benefit applies to those pre-ordering or pre-purchasing the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h2]Pre-order Modern Warfare 4 Today[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/385129643de279ac149570e29ddf4101ac5fa03b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Stay tuned to the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] information by checking the Call of Duty Blog through launch and beyond.[/p][p]Pre-orders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at [url="https://www.callofduty.com/"]CallofDuty.com[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]* Actual Play Time Subject to Possible Outages and Applicable Time Zone Differences. Actual platform availability and start date subject to change.[/p]

newsitems.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4: The Story So Far
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/52a64926c9a1dd712c88aa7a3a9d944543c499f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare 4[/i], war erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches a full-scale invasion, while half a world away, John Price wages a personal war while on the run from those hunting him.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="tmCV1hj6z5Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p]How did the former leader of Task Force 141 end up operating outside official channels? And what are the major events that have led to this point? As we approach the October 23 launch date for Modern Warfare 4 — with Campaign Early Access* going live on October 16 for those who pre-order the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game — let’s revisit the key narrative moments leading up to the game’s launch.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Story So Far: The Events of Modern Warfare (2019)[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e6b53e9da1c2ad01c6dfa31773a1a3b37c3dd8d0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The very first flashpoint was Verdansk, when a squad of Marines and CIA operative Alex Keller raided a military depot belonging to rogue Russian General Roman Barkov. Their mission? Retrieve an illegal shipment of weaponized chlorine gas intended for use in Urzikstan without sparking an international incident.[/p][p]The group achieves their objective, but before they can safely extract the gas, they’re ambushed by an unknown terrorist group. The Marines are slaughtered in the surprise attack, the gas is stolen, and Alex is forced to call in an emergency evac as hostile forces converge on their position.[/p][p]Twenty-four hours later, terrorist organization Al-Qatala conduct a coordinated attack in London’s Piccadilly Circus. SAS Captain John Price and Sergeant Kyle “Gaz” Garrick respond to the deadly attack, culminating in an infamous night vision raid in North London, leading to intel on the location of Al-Qatala’s leader, codenamed “The Wolf.” [/p][p][/p][h3]The Invasion of Urzikstan[/h3][p][i]“The enemy has come where they are not welcomed and taking what is not theirs.”[/i] — Commander Farah Karim[/p][p][/p][p]Seeking the new whereabouts of the stolen gas, CIA Station Chief Kate Laswell sends Alex to Urzikstan to meet up with Commander Farah Karim of the Urzikstan Liberation Force. She more than has her work cut out for her as Urzikstan faces a two-pronged threat posed by Al-Qatala and the illegal Russian military occupation led by General Barkov.[/p][p]Alex and Farah make a deal. If he helps her fight the Russians, she and her forces will help him recover the stolen chemical weapons. In the first major joint strike between the CIA and ULF, the allied forces attack and dismantle the Al-Raab Airbase being used to conduct airstrikes. Stripped of air superiority, Barkov’s grip weakens in the region.[/p][p]Following this operation, Alex and Sergeant Marcus Griggs join the U.S. Marine Corps Demon Dogs assault force in a raid to capture “The Wolf” across the outskirts and throughout the Rammaza Hospital in Urzikstan.[/p][p]In an unexpected twist, the allied forces discover that the chemical shipment was not originally stolen by Al-Qatala but by Farah’s brother, Hadir Karim. Incensed at Barkov’s subjugation of Urzikstan, Karim, the second-in-command of the ULF, orchestrated the theft of chemical weapons to use against the invading Russians. To prevent an international incident, Kate Laswell turns Karim over to the Russian government.[/p][p]To shut down Barkov’s operation for good, Captain Price and his joint task force launch a raid on the chemical weapons production site in Georgia. In the final moments, Alex seemingly sacrifices himself to destroy the facility, while Farah hunts down and eliminates General Barkov.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Beginning of Task Force 141[/h3][p][i]“General Shepherd pulled the files you asked for. What exactly is this about?”[/i] — Station Chief Kate Laswell[/p][p][/p][p]Following the terrorist attack in London and the operation in Urzikstan, Captain Price requests the personnel files for Kyle “Gaz” Garrick, Johnny “Soap” MacTavish, and Simon “Ghost” Riley. These operators would form the core team of Task Force 141. Under Price’s leadership with support from Station Chief Kate Laswell, Task Force 141 is created as a tier one counterterrorism unit, capable of bypassing traditional military channels to deal with emerging crises around the world.[/p][p]Little did they know that in gaining this execute authority, Captain Price and Task Force 141 would soon discover a conspiracy occurring right under their noses, putting them in direct odds with their superior, General Shepherd.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Events of Modern Warfare II (2022)[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f154f0ca7f6179399636abc9a94bda74508df61f.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]General Shepherd and Shadow Company[/h3][p][i]“To do good, you’ve gotta do some bad.”[/i] — General Shepherd[/p][p][/p][p]In Shepherd’s mind, the threat posed by the Russians in Urzikstan is too great to address purely through official channels. In partnership with Shadow Company, a PMC founded by Commander Phillip Graves, Shepherd orders the illegal smuggling of U.S. ballistic missiles into the hands of American allies in the Middle East.[/p][p]The whole operation goes FUBAR as Russian ultranationalists belonging to the Konni Group intercept the missiles. The botched mission is a disaster, delivering American weapons into the hands of antagonist Vladimir Makarov.[/p][p]Rather than face the repercussions for his actions, General Shepherd determines to cover up the incident, ordering Graves and Shadow Company to keep a lid on things by silencing anyone who gets too close to the truth of what happened. In choosing to do so, Shepherd sets a fuse on his collision course with Captain Price.[/p][p][/p][h3]Betrayal in Mexico[/h3][p][i]“You boys have been relieved. Thank you for your service.”[/i] — Commander Phillip Graves[/p][p][/p][p]To maintain deniability, Makarov and the ultranationalists transfer the stolen missiles to Iranian Major Hassan Zyani who then pays the Las Almas Cartel, led by Valeria Garza, to smuggle the missiles across the Mexican American border. If the missiles can be transported and stored inside North America, they can hit their intended targets within the country.[/p][p]To tackle the critical mission, Task Force 141 and Shadow Company team up with Los Vaqueros, a Mexican Special Forces unit led by Colonel Alejandro Vargas. The joint force successfully tracks down and dismantles two of the three stolen missiles, but while in the field, Ghost and Soap discover that the lost missiles are American made. When they radio it in, a defensive General Shepherd orders them to ignore the missiles’ origins and destroy them.[/p][p]In a shocking act of betrayal, Commander Graves and Shadow Company turn on Task Force 141 and Los Vaqueros in Las Almas while they are still hunting for the final missile. In the ensuing shootout, Alejandro is detained and imprisoned, Soap is wounded, and Ghost escapes, slipping into the shadows during the confrontation.[/p][p]The drastic turns against Task Force 141 and Los Vaqueros is the result of their meddling in General Shepherd’s mess. It was time they were cut off.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Events of Modern Warfare III (2023)[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/42d0aab4d8cccf378a1310cba8c96c6c677c9cbd.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Makarov Targets the West[/h3][p][i]“Never bury your enemies alive.”[/i] — Vladimir Makarov[/p][p][/p][p]As Makarov’s false flag operations repeatedly meet with resistance from Task Force 141, he decides on a more drastic act. Instead of engaging in proxy warfare, Makarov shifts his focus to Western Europe with a plan to destroy the Channel Tunnel, a critical transit link connecting the UK and France. The attack would destabilize Europe and inflame global tensions.[/p][p]When Task Force 141 discovers Makarov’s plan to detonate a dirty bomb inside the underwater thoroughfare, Captain Price and Soap move in to track it down and defuse it. After pushing into the London underground tunnels, they find the bomb and Soap gets to work defusing it. While doing so, Makarov ambushes them, gunning for Captain Price. Intent on saving Price, Soap lunges forward and stabs Makarov. In retaliation, Makarov shoots Soap in the head, killing him.[/p][p][/p][h3]Assassinating General Shepherd[/h3][p][i]“I am not going to beg for my life.”[/i] — General Shepherd[/p][p][/p][p]In response to Soap’s death, Price takes matters into his own hands, starting with General Shepherd whose actions allowed Makarov to prosper in the first place. By seeking to save his own skin and ordering Shadow Company to turn on Task Force 141, Makarov was able to expand his operations without interference. It was time for Shepherd to pay for his mistakes.[/p][p]Sneaking into Shepherd’s office at night, Price assassinates the general. In doing so, he is forced underground while conducting his own manhunt for Markarov.[/p][p][/p][h2]A New Invasion[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aec2d2180abe947be0675a3e6b593161e7127ad9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]From trench warfare in Korea and close-quarters combat in New York to high-speed chases through Paris, SAS night raids in Mumbai, and a citywide assault to reclaim occupied territory, Modern Warfare 4 delivers a globe-trotting Campaign that takes the series into darker, more dangerous territory.[/p][p]It all kicks off with the full-scale invasion of South Korea’s Hajin City, setting a new ground for warfare without limits. [/p][p][/p][h3]Price Gone Dark[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4adfa81185a4e2a00f5d1790427ed06409bfe3a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Following the assassination of General Shepherd, operator-turned-outlaw John Price now works outside the system he once served. A hunt for revenge draws him toward a weapon powerful enough to shift the balance of power, setting in motion a conflict far greater than he ever anticipated. Forced into uneasy alliances and illicit operations, Price is pulled deeper into consequences he can no longer escape.[/p][p]Whether you’ve played the previous [i]Modern Warfare[/i] titles or not, you now have the intel you need to jump right into [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]. Get ready for a wild ride.[/p][p][/p][h3]Campaign Early Access* Begins October 16[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ef678fcea54e3b6d9b49d59a796313f58f2b262e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Starting on Friday, October 16, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] get Early Access* to the game’s Campaign.[/p][p]This benefit applies to those pre-ordering or pre-purchasing the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h2]Pre-order Modern Warfare 4 Today[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b2395cb219133aa692f4295a5f11d55ca1972ebe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Stay tuned to the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] information by checking the Call of Duty Blog through launch and beyond. [/p][p]Pre-orders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at [url="https://www.callofduty.com/"]CallofDuty.com[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][i]*Actual Play Time Subject to Possible Outages and Applicable Time Zone Differences. Actual platform availability and start date subject to change.[/i] [/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone - Season 06
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/576f539228171212688a34e304f59274605f6557.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Outlast the Unknown: Black Ops Season 06 is Here![/h2][p][/p][h3]The Haunting[/h3][p]The Haunting returns and there’s nowhere to hide! Season 06 is brimming with evil as fright-filled maps and modes arrive as part of a colossal update that will satisfy your sweet tooth to Halloween and beyond. [/p][p][/p][h3]Season 06 Roadmap[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/53793f7b90276244fa77960d27c24cb7bce6ce93.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Across [i]Call of Duty® Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone[/i]™, Season 06 amps up the scares with Haunted Hollow, where cosmic horrors and a Ghost Train infiltrate the small-town Resurgence map. In Multiplayer, rack up the kills in the Quantum and Bloodstead maps, Hordepoint mode, and face off on Zombies locations in MP during T.E.D.D. Trials. Conjure a terrifying foe in Endgame’s Forbidden Summoning Event as night descends upon Avalon and face off against pumpkin-headed hordes in Zombies across a slew of grisly new content. [/p][p]Brave the horrors with an assortment of new Base Weapons earned in the Battle Pass and through in-game events, including the TR51 Para Assault Rifle, the iconic VMP SMG, Arcblade Melee Weapon, and Roc 20mm Special Weapon. Unlock new Attachments through Weekly Challenges, summon the forces of Hell with a DOOM-themed Event and Bundle, and much more.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jWcjHH5g6IA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Join in for a frightfully good time when Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Season 06 launches on September 17 at 9AM PT.[/p][p][/p][h2]Black Ops 7: Endgame Content[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Night Falls on Avalon:[/b] The Haunting brings nightfall to Endgame’s Avalon, changing up the gameplay experience as Operators take on Activities and Assignments after dark.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New World Event:[/b] A new guest has arrived with The Haunting. Call upon the darkness in the Forbidden Summoning Event.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Avalon Night (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c11d81bb55b125f5bb2368d5964d9a82c4b50aed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Endgame, night descends on Avalon, plunging Operators into an eerie landscape where Fears, Guild opponents, and other obstacles seek to eliminate squads under the cover of night.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Forbidden Summoning Event (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2574071cdc1074a813fe495600e29f6b8c540f20.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Avalon has a new guest courtesy of The Haunting. Unlock the seals to free an ancient threat in the Forbidden Summoning Event and bring plenty of backup to receive its worthy rewards.[/p][p][/p][h2]Black Ops 7: Multiplayer Content[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] Breach an Arctic computing facility in the frigid Quantum, encounter unexplainable horrors in Bloodstead, and drop into Zombies-themed maps Roadkill, Lost, and Inferno for the competitive T.E.D.D. Trials.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Limited-Time Modes:[/b] In T.E.D.D. Trials, victory goes to the team who completes the most tasks, featuring 6v6 matchups across three Zombies maps. In Hordepoint, control the objective to turn the undead against your foes, and immobilize the enemy in Freeze Tag.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Black Ops 7 Ranked Play:[/b] Get wins and climb the Ranks in the next season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, including new seasonal rewards.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Quantum (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9d34343ee2f5a7fb2e0f25b1f04a572842c704d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Seize upon a Guild quantum computing facility buried within the Arctic ice before its secrets are lost. In this narrow map, Operators must brave the cold and snow across the facility’s frigid outdoor spaces including the Courtyard, Square, and Catwalk, while the map’s interior spaces bring combat to a fever pitch in tight areas like the Servers, Maintenance, Hallway, and the frozen Turbine. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7c899e0ec45a73fad051755b475fc2e594a9e33b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Damage inflicted on the structure has revealed new routes and cover, including openings in the roof of the central Tower, giving room for aerial streaks to find their way in. The Tower draws attention with a dangerous play space marked with dense cover, openings on all four sides, and a concealed flanking path in the center. Using speed and precision, work with your teammates to calculate a winning score.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bloodstead (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Retheme, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a37e2b758ebde67f087dd00dc46a7ae51e8a978d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight through a forsaken Homestead as an unexplained horror descends on the Mason home. BlackCell daily challenges count toward the three challenges required to earn Daily Challenge Bonus XP.[/p][p][b]BlackCell Loyalty Bonus:[/b] Players who purchased Season 05 BlackCell and go on to purchase Season 06 BlackCell will activate a permanent 10% Player and Weapon XP bonus in Black Ops 7 (up to a 50% bonus for purchasing BlackCell in every Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 season!).[/p][p][/p][h3]Blueprints with BlackCell Variants[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c63c1c5f39fa47ef244779416bb31b0370fc5431.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Above) “Bad Luck” MK35 ISR Assault Rifle and “Bad Luck” BlackCell variant, HVT, Page 1.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/637d65fe45a3813b24f1302034e067c954af8d11.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Above) “Membrane” Echo 12 Shotgun and “Membrane” BlackCell variant, HVT Page 4.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fc427e38bd90433fa7b051e284c3cb5336ef0658.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Above) “Bloodwash” MPC-25 SMG and “Bloodwash” BlackCell variant, HVT Page 8.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/30accc0d160d4f72406ccba1ce3cc9ef91cfac8d.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Above) “Don’t Blink” Shadow SK Sniper Rifle and “Don’t Blink” BlackCell variant, HVT Page 10.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1d0eba7fd6dd3aab8ec535f5362329efd5996478.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Above) “Smoke Point” New Season 06 TR51 Para Assault Rifle and “Smoke Point” BlackCell variant, HVT Page 12.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d17f65344ca0a92970944b57d3926ce47ab260fb.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Above) “Apeiron” VX Compact Assault Rifle and “Apeiron” BlackCell variant, HVT Page 14.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/38999e2ae5610706e1e7380384c0d5b41009a6b1.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Above) “Tooth Ache” New Season 06 VMP SMG and “Tooth Ache” BlackCell variant, HVT Page 15.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Operators[/h3][p]Dispatch foes with the BlackCell Revenant Collection leading Season 06 BlackCell content. His equipment pairs experimental systems with reactive resin masking and chroma-shifting armor, allowing him to hunt from the shadows while his targets are unaware. This technology — unreliable in untrained hands — is maintained personally by Revenant between deployments.[/p][p]Methodical under pressure, Revenant is uniquely adapted for assessing hostile networks and identifying weaknesses and infiltration routes. No physical facility or digital fortress is safe when he lays his sights on it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Blackjack (Battle Pass, Guild, Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]“Blackjack” and “Zenith” Skins: Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, Battle Pass Completion Page[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aacd7bb6271f48debe92f20a9d4dea7a7b961879.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Discreet, adaptable, and uniquely resourceful, Danny “Blackjack” Li’s ability to work in the spaces between criminal syndicates and military contracts have made him an increasingly recognizable name in the global arms trade.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Doom Slayer (Battle Pass, JSOC, In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]“Doom Slayer” and “Doom Guy” Skins, DOOM Event Pass Rewards[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/553dbff24173f6a1560e0b0becbe0c538717e37f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the first age, in the first battle, when the shadows first lengthened, one stood. He wore the crown of the Night Sentinels, and those that tasted the bite of his sword named him… Doom Slayer.[/p][p][/p][h3]Additional Battle Pass and BlackCell Operator Skins[/h3][p]Progress through
