newsitems.contents: В 2021 году американское руководство Bungie объявило о масштабном расширении (почти в три раза) штаб-квартиры студии в штате Вашингтон. По данным СМИ, на кампус площадью 1,9 гектара было потрачено несколько сотен миллионов долларов.

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta: Maps and Modes
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [h2]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Modes[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f701a27b2c00ca3f48885177ef8f1bcabe342463.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]NOTE:[/b] This intel comes from the Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Everything You Need to Know Blog. [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/08/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-open-beta-everything-you-need-to-know"]Click here for the full blog[/url][/u].[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Open Beta showcases the full range of Multiplayer combat. Deploy into classic modes like Team Deathmatch and Domination, master all-new experiences including Hijack and Inflation, test your skills in intense 3v3 Gunfight matches, or join combined-arms Ground War battles featuring tanks and other vehicles. Explore the mode overviews below.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]Team Deathmatch (Core 6v6)[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cad7ed36900c3be7aede483734b297ce6fc21d0e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Eliminate enemy Operators to earn points for your team.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The first team to reach the score limit or the lead when time expires wins the match.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Unlimited respawns keep the action moving while rewarding smart engagements, teamwork, and consistent gunplay.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Full Create a Class functionality lets you experiment with all available weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrades, and Killstreaks.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Team Deathmatch is [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer in its purest form. Two teams compete to earn points by eliminating enemy Operators, with every kill bringing your team one step closer to victory. Without objectives to capture or defend, success comes from consistently winning engagements while denying the enemy opportunities to score.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9aabf73dc4db41e5e23f41c096a7e0f973afdeb8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every elimination counts but surviving to fight the next battle is just as important. Winning consecutive engagements not only denies the enemy points; it also earns valuable Killstreaks that can strengthen your team's advantage. Whether you're jumping into your first Multiplayer match or sharpening your gunfighting skills before tackling objective-based modes, Team Deathmatch rewards smart decision-making, teamwork, and consistent performance.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]Hijack (Core 6v6)[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e736bb153f80fa9982c4352f608799e47125daad.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Fight to capture a Data Spike around the central area of the map.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Carry, throw, or pass the Spike to teammates as you advance.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Plant the Spike at the enemy Comm Station to earn points over time, plus a bonus score when it detonates.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Defuse enemy Spikes before they can score.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Hijack is a brand-new objective mode where both teams battle over a single Data Spike, then advance it toward the enemy Comm Station. Once planted, the Spike continuously generates points for your team, forcing the opposition to launch a counterattack before it detonates or risk falling behind.[/p][p][/p][p]Victory depends on momentum as much as firepower. Keep the Spike moving by carrying it yourself or throwing it to teammates to maintain the attack. Full Create a Class functionality gives your team multiple ways to escort the Spike, disrupt enemy advances, and defend the objective as you fight to maximize your score.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7322fe0958413269336c2300e54085efad7d6e42.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]HIJACK: TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]Protect the carrier:[/i][/b][i] While carrying the Data Spike, the Lethal input is used to throw it, preventing the carrier from deploying their equipped Lethal. Teammates should clear dangerous routes, support their carrier with their Equipment, and be ready to recover the Spike if the carrier is eliminated.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Keep the Spike moving:[/i][/b][i] A stationary Spike gives the enemy time to regroup. Carry it, throw it to a teammate, or quickly recover it after a firefight to maintain the attack.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Fight for the Comm Station:[/i][/b][i] Planting the Spike is only half the battle. Prepare defensive positions before the enemy counterattack arrives and protect the Spike until it detonates.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Use the fight equipment for the job:[/i][/b][i] The carrier loses access to their equipped Lethal, making the surrounding squad’s loadout choices especially important. Use equipment and Killstreaks to clear routes, protect the advance, and secure the Comm Station after planting.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Adapt as the Spike moves:[/i][/b][i] Every time the Data Spike resets, both teams race to regain possession. Recover quickly, adjust your routes, and don't allow the enemy time to establish their next defense.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]Inflation (Core 6v6)[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7eec7bf41a88cc58a7d9e7a1be086d96dac87201.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Eliminate enemies to collect cash and build your fortune.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Defeat wealthy HVT Operators to steal the cash they're carrying.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The richest players become marked High Value Targets for everyone to hunt.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Survive the escalating chaos of Overtime, where increased cash multipliers can dramatically swing the match.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Inflation is a new Multiplayer mode that transforms every successful Operator into a bigger prize… and target. Eliminate enemies to collect cash, but the more wealth you carry, the greater the target on your back. Once you reach the High Value Target threshold, your position is revealed, inviting the entire enemy team to hunt you down while your teammates defend your position, recover dropped cash, and continue building their own fortunes.[/p][p][/p][p]As fortunes grow, so do the stakes. Every elimination can dramatically swing the score as teams choose whether to protect their richest players or launch coordinated attacks against enemy High Value Targets. Overtime raises the tension even further with increased cash multipliers, creating a chaotic finale where fortunes can change hands in moments. Full Create a Class functionality gives your team the tools to hunt High Value Targets, defend your biggest earners, and survive the escalating chaos as the match reaches its dramatic conclusion.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]INFLATION: TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]Think beyond eliminations:[/i][/b][i] Every fight is an opportunity to earn cash, recover dropped wealth, deny the enemy a payout, or eliminate an HVT. The best play isn't always the next gunfight.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Protect your biggest earners:[/i][/b][i] HVTs become priority targets for the opposing team. Stay close enough to defend them while maintaining crossfires and multiple angles.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Recover dropped cash quickly:[/i][/b][i] Eliminated Operators drop cash that either team can collect. Denying the enemy these recoveries is often just as valuable as securing them yourself.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Prepare for Overtime:[/i][/b][i] Increased cash multipliers make the closing moments the most valuable phase of the match. Save powerful Killstreaks, Field Upgrades, and coordinated pushes for when they can have the greatest impact.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3]Domination (Core 6v6)[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Capture and defend three objectives marked A, B, and C.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Holding objectives generates points for your team.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Teams switch sides once half the score limit has been reached.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The first team to 200 points wins.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Domination is one of [i]Call of Duty[/i]'s signature objective modes, challenging teams to capture and defend three strategic objectives across a Core 6v6 map. Every objective under your team's control generates points over time, rewarding teams that balance aggressive captures with disciplined defense while denying the enemy opportunities to score.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Holding territory is the key to victory. Teams switch sides at halftime, requiring both teams to attack and defend from each side of the map before the match concludes. Unlimited respawns, Perks, Killstreaks, and full Create a Class functionality encourage communication, map control, and coordinated objective play.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Hardpoint (Core 6v6)[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/02160510c120faabe8ad974ee18f3161538567b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Capture and hold the active Hardpoint to earn points for your team.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Only one teammate is required inside the Hardpoint to score.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Hardpoints rotate to a new location every minute.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The first team to 250 points wins.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Hardpoint puts both teams in a race to control a single scoring zone marked by a visible perimeter. Holding the Hardpoint continuously earns points for your team, but only while your team controls the objective uncontested. With unlimited respawns, every moment spent holding the Hardpoint matters.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Every minute, the Hardpoint rotates to the next location, forcing both teams to reposition and fight for control again. Unlimited respawns, full Create a Class functionality, Perks, Killstreaks, and Field Upgrades encourage coordinated pushes, disciplined defense, and smart rotations between Hardpoints.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]Kill Confirmed (Core 6v6)[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b][i]QUICK INTEL:[/i][/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Eliminate enemies and collect their Dog Tags to score for your team.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Recover friendly Dog Tags to deny enemy points.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Eliminations alone do not increase your team's score.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The first team to reach the score limit wins.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Kill Confirmed adds an extra objective to every engagement. Eliminating an enemy causes them to drop a Dog Tag. Recover enemy Dog Tags to score points for your team, while collecting friendly tags denies the enemy the opportunity to score. Dog Tags can quickly become flashpoints, with both teams fighting to recover or deny them.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Success depends on more than accurate shooting. Strong teams know when to secure a nearby tag, when to deny the enemy a point, and when to leave a dangerous tag behind. Full Create a Class functionality, Perks, Killstreaks, and Field Upgrades provide countless ways to recover friendly tags, secure enemy tags, and fight through contested pickups.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]Search and Destroy (Core 6v6)[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/231088053f7eca35c47b197b3b57a0db17d79a89.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Attackers win by eliminating the enemy team or detonating the bomb.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Defenders win by eliminating the attackers, preventing the bomb plant, or defusing the bomb.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]One life per round. No respawns.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Search and Destroy is a classic round-based attack-versus-defense mode, where every player gets a single life to help plant or defuse the bomb at one of two sites. The high stakes, dramatic reversals, and clutch plays have made it one of the franchise's defining Multiplayer experiences.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7dc32f1cfe9537ffb8549f873f67d4691671ee46.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every round raises the stakes. With no respawns, each elimination reduces your team's fighting strength, leaving the remaining Operators to adapt as the odds shift throughout the round. Attackers must plant and defend the bomb, while defenders work to stop the plant or defuse the bomb before it detonates. Teams switch sides every round, requiring both squads to master attack and defense.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Accurate shooting, communication, teamwork, and the intelligent use of information are often the deciding factors, while full Create a Class functionality provides the tools to gather intel on enemy route plans and positions, protect objectives, support teammates, and secure crucial round wins.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Core Multiplayer Maps (6v6)[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Battle across a selection of Core 6v6 maps from the 12 maps available at launch.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Experience a diverse selection of global conflict zones featuring elevated rooftops, dense shopping districts, industrial facilities, rail terminals, and battle-damaged coastal villages.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Every core map offers its own layout, engagement ranges, and tactical opportunities.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta features a selection of the 12 Core 6v6 maps available at launch. Each map delivers its own combat rhythm, from sprawling rooftops and compact urban streets to industrial complexes and battle-scarred villages. Learn the layouts, identify key landmarks, and discover what makes every map unique with the Map images showcased below:[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Cachette[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/711b2c4a159f65fc26d647e1ca26b16d3db24160.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight across a secret hideout next to a French rail terminal where cobblestone streets, shipping containers, rooftops, and compact interior spaces combine to create a tightly connected arena packed with flanking opportunities and upper floor routes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]CACHETTE TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Incoming strike:[/b] Punish the enemy by striking critical routes along the Backlot, Central Containers, and Front Gate with explosive Killstreaks like the Bomb Glider and Artillery Beacon. Keep up the pressure by equipping the Hardline Perk to earn your streaks faster.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Feet off the ground:[/b] If you’re not getting results on the ground, climb up for a better view. Jump across the containers and rooftops in the middle for an expanded view with quick access into the Armory and Lounge while maintaining the second story advantage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zap ’em with the Zip Gun: [/b]If your weapon isn’t suited for close-quarters fights, bring the Zip Gun Lethal along as a defensive measure when you’re forced inside. The 3D printed, single-use pistol is quickly deployed, making it an ideal tool in narrow spaces like the Garage, Armory, and Server Room.[/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3]Lithium[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f06439d7c40331b71e2a91cdf53f206a15288c8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Enter a damaged lithium processing facility in rural Mexico, where industrial buildings, processing equipment, interactive garage doors, and strong mid-range sightlines support a wide variety of combat styles.[/p][p][/p][p][b]LITHIUM TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Score big in the mid-range:[/b] Mid-ranged sightlines dominate Lithium, making it a great map for Assault Rifles, LMGs, and Marksman Rifles. Experiment with different Optics and Gunsmith configurations to find the mid-ranged option that best compliments your playstyle across the facility.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Garage slide:[/b] You can press the buttons by the garage doors to toggle them open and partially shut. In the shut position, there’s just enough room to slide underneath. Use the opportunity to surprise enemies on the other side, firing your weapon mid-slide for a stylish finish.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Truck cover:[/b] Get in the back of the camouflaged truck parked on the eastern Road for an excellent vantage point covering the immediate area including sights toward the Runoff Area and Refinery.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Lotus[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e0f7934492e0d5c2468bb0087a3c21567df5da21.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Experience a battle-scarred Korean fishing village where abandoned tanks, burning buildings, narrow streets, and accessible interiors blend close quarters combat with longer sightlines across a main thoroughfare.[/p][p][/p][p][b]LOTUS TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Diversify with Overkill:[/b] Adapt on the fly with the Overkill Perk, allowing you to equip two Primary Weapons to your Loadout. Pair a Marksman Rifle and SMG or some other combo that gives you one option when fighting in the open and another for engaging enemies up close.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boathouse pipe:[/b] Climb the pipe outside the Boathouse to reach the lower roof and second floor. Stay outside to cover the Docks or duck into the burning building to fight inside. If things get too hot, you can always dive into the Water. Bring a Pistol.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Room clear:[/b] Take a Shotgun into tight spaces like the Restaurant, Hostel, Fish Market, and Boathouse. Keep up the pressure to dislodge enemies attempting to get a foothold in these core locations.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Rooftops[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd334fc7bca39e62973404044733589e4e598a0a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Battle across the snow-covered rooftops of New York's Hotel Times West, where elevated platforms, exterior walkways, and compact interior spaces reward precision movement while offering multiple routes around the city block.[/p][p][/p][p][b]ROOTOPS TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Catwalk ambush:[/b] Drop down to the Catwalk on the east side of Construction to get out of sight and set up ambushes against unsuspecting Operators. Catch them from behind to execute a Finishing Move.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clear the skies:[/b] Use the map’s density to find some breathing room when you need to handle enemy aerial threats. It’s a clear shot overhead, so bring a Launcher and help your team by downing UAVs and other airborne threats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Party at the Patio:[/b] Get behind the Patio counter for a protected view over the large Construction zone. When the area gets hot, slip into the Laundry or Electrical Room, or throw enemies off by jumping onto the Scaffolding and attacking from there.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Silkworm[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/259d78f2ad4b45cc23f9fc10cc3bad257726ddb3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight through a dense South Korean shopping district centered on a busy subway entrance. Storefronts, alleyways, apartments, and narrow streets keep combat fast, grounded, and focused on close- to mid-range engagements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]SILKWORM TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ground fight:[/b] Silkworm keeps fights grounded with street level combat, featuring minimal vantage points in favor of face-to-face skirmishes. Look for Attachments that improve your Aim Down Sight Speed and other weapon handling bonuses to quicken your response time against enemies rounding the next alleyway or storefront.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Chain reaction:[/b] Main Street is lined with vehicles, several of them grouped up in tight clusters. Inflict damage to the engine to set cars on fire, resulting in an explosion. Heavy armaments like Frag Grenades, Launchers, and LMGs tend to work best. Time your attack to catch enemies in the blast. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Game Room hero:[/b] Shoot for a high score in the Game Room. Close-quarters Loadouts excel there. Watch the Convenience Store from behind the front counter and use the pillars out back as cover on the way toward the Warehouse and Basketball Court. There’s a lot to work with in a small area, keeping fights fast and frenetic.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Transit 213[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/990295c75b98a711ed9bbc49fb2986f4ab155fb5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Expect skirmishes throughout an overgrown Indian bus depot where a parking lot of rusting buses divide the battlefield into tight lanes, concealed routes, and close-range ambushes balanced by impressive sightlines across the Center Lot.[/p][p][/p][p][b]TRANSIT 213 TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Unleash the arsenal:[/b] The smaller the map, the easier it is to affect enemies with your Equipment and Field Upgrade. Clear out the open busses with Frag Grenades, obscure your movements with a Smoke Grenade, defend your position with a Trophy System… the more variety you add to your plays, the better your chances of winning the round. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Center Lot dead zone:[/b] Beware the Center Lot busses. They provide cover and concealment against targets on the ground, but their central position makes them easy to rush and often the target of incoming grenades. Always look for enemies inside, and don’t linger too long near the windows. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick on the draw:[/b] Speed up your actions with the Fast Hands Perk to reload, use Equipment, and swap weapons faster. On a small map like Transit, it pays to minimize your time spent on these actions so you’re ready to go in the next fight.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Gunfight (3v3, 10v10, Kill Block)[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3035cf383c4720427652e9208ab867a45d808a5a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Gunfight returns on Kill Block, featuring 3v3 and the all-new 10v10 variants.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Single-life rounds featuring randomized shared loadouts.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Kill Block reconfigures every two rounds with a new Combo and Loadout rotation.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Eliminate the opposing team or capture the Overtime Flag to win the round.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Gunfight returns in the [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]Beta, bringing its signature single-life elimination gameplay to Kill Block. Fight in either 3v3 or the all-new 10v10 variant as teams battle across ever-changing Kill Block map Combos, with every player using the same randomized Loadout. Victory comes through teamwork, weapon proficiency, and adapting quickly as both the map and your equipment change throughout the match.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6a3e4766b3f60f95495163ee55ff23fbd8c3f30.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every two rounds, Kill Block reconfigures into a new Combo — a trio of connected scenic Slabs — while a new randomized Loadout is issued to every player. Teams swap spawn sides between rounds, ensuring both sides compete on the same layout with identical equipment before the next Combo is randomly created. If neither team secures the elimination before time expires, an Overtime Flag appears, forcing one final fight for the round.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/62299e7f942d7c949190d6c8b609e7ed6e1ebba3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]KILL BLOCK GUNFIGHT: TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Squad up:[/b] A lone Operator is an easy target. Push with teammates, trade eliminations, and communicate enemy positions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Master every Loadout.[/b] Every player receives the same randomized weapons, so success comes from adapting quickly rather than relying on a favorite class.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Play both sides.[/b] Teams swap spawn points every round, giving each side an opportunity to attack and defend the same Combo before it changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Break the stalemate:[/b] Don't forget the Overtime Flag. If neither team is eliminated before time expires, the Overtime Flag becomes the fastest route to victory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Win the opening fight and use equipment wisely.[/b] Tactical and Lethal Equipment unlock shortly after each round begins. Win the opening engagement with positioning and gunplay before relying on equipment.[/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h2]Combat Outpost (24v24, Ground War)[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2934795f76b73954696c7dd2fcd1fe4c265108fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]NEW Ground War mode for Modern Warfare 4 available across two large-scale maps.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Large-scale objective combat across a sprawling battleground featuring infantry and vehicles.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Captured Outposts become additional spawn locations for your team, expanding your team’s front line.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Unlock escalating team rewards, from Local UAV coverage to armored vehicle support.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Combat Outpost reimagines Domination for Ground War, expanding the familiar three-flag battle into a large-scale conflict across a sprawling battleground. Capture Outposts to earn a steady stream of points while expanding your team's available spawn locations, allowing friendly forces to reinforce the front line and maintain pressure across the map.[/p][p][/p][p]The battle doesn't end once an Outpost is secured. Continue Reinforcing captured positions to unlock increasingly powerful team rewards, from Local UAV coverage and a JLTV airdrop to a Light Tank delivered straight to your Headquarters. With Capture and Reinforce objectives often overlapping, Combat Outpost rewards coordinated teams that can seize territory, defend key positions, and leverage the battlefield advantages they earn.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h2]Ground War Multiplayer Maps (24v24, Beta)[/h2][p][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Battle across two large-scale Combat Outpost battlegrounds set within the Haijin region.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fight between open countryside and dense urban terrain with infantry and vehicle combat across both maps.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Both maps offer unique routes, landmarks, and tactical opportunities.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Combat Outpost spans two distinct large-scale theaters of conflict, each offering a different approach to Ground War combat. Whether crossing open farmland or fighting through dense urban streets, learning the terrain, major landmarks, and key routes is essential to supporting your team and maintaining control of the match.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Imjin Farmlands[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/de000d116d85e2d26922844594ee4a2eba040538.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Battle across the rural outskirts of Haijin, where open fields, waterways, scattered farms, and the large-scale mill combine with roads and rail lines to create a combat zone suited to long sightlines, vehicle maneuvering, and coordinated assaults on key strongholds.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]IMJIN FARMLANDS TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Against the grain:[/b] The mill towers over the Imjin Farmlands, making it a prime spot for snipers and Operators looking to get a lay of the land from up high. When approaching from the outskirts, use cover to minimize sightlines onto your position and work with teammates to breach the inner facility from multiple angles. Once inside, switch to close-ranged weapons to speed up combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Road tax:[/b] The Imjin Farmlands are relatively flat with narrow roads and shortcuts connecting its various sections. When facing enemy vehicles, carry a Launcher into battle and use the even terrain to land hits on target. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Hold for reinforcements:[/b] Don’t just capture and run. In Combat Outpost, victory depends on reinforcing your positions, earning powerful rewards over time including armored vehicles, tanks, and a twin-engine helicopter. Get the goods and then go into battle with the advantage.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3] Wolves Stadium[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c53c46a7fec33520fea9b6d89f2692f528e349b5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight through the heart of Haijin in a dense urban environment centered on the Wolves Stadium. Multi-story buildings, transit lines, tunnels, rooftops, and surrounding hillsides create a highly versatile arena of battle where every route offers multiple ways to advance.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]WOLVES STADIUM TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Amphitheater ambush:[/b] Ambush foes from the amphitheater stage, protected by a circle of terrain that’s difficult for vehicles to penetrate. Wolves Stadium is full of defensible POIs like this; achieving victory is partly in knowing when to buckle down and defend and when to move on toward the next target.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ascend: [/b]Look for ascenders, ladders, pipes, and anything else that you can use to quickly scale structures. Especially in the thick of downtown, using these shortcuts to obtain a vantage point ASAP will help you lock down critical routes with minimal setup.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Refill for Killstreaks:[/b] Play the long game by sticking near Outposts where you can refill your supplies and fend off attackers from a fortified position. Build up your Killstreaks so that when it’s time to push forward or defend against a large attack, you have the extra support to help turn the battle in your favor.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h2]Call of Duty: Warzone™ Resurgence (44 players, Zodiac Map)[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c53c46a7fec33520fea9b6d89f2692f528e349b5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW: [/i][/b][i]Experience Resurgence on the all-new Zodiac map during Weekend Two of the Modern Warfare 4 Beta.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Battle across the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly headquarters.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Stay alive while your teammates redeploy, then eliminate enemies and complete Contracts to shorten their return timer.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Outlast every opposing squad to secure the win.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1665ed163616d40761d6efa3a75821cfa3a74b04.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Resurgence returns with the all-new Zodiac, a compact combat zone built around the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly and manufacturing headquarters.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/748b7174fb26a06bab7d0f69e83162660af3ab9a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight from the company Admin building through and beneath the central double Trackline with multiple trains, then push toward the R&D facility and shipping docks as squads battle across offices, manufacturing buildings, rooftops, tunnels, and the surrounding shoreline. Expect an explosive tank battle, legendary loot, action across the ground and air, and other surprises to find during your matches.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/26fed4c05111d61c9254db786e3696a8f4fd208d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every Loadout has room to dominate and are default for the Beta. Choose from AR, SMG, LMG, or Sniper Default Loadouts. Close-range Operators can weave between buildings and through the center of the facility, while longer-range Loadouts benefit from rooftops and elevated windows overlooking the facility’s points of interest. Beneath it all, an underground tunnel network offers another way to rotate, flank enemy squads, or briefly disappear before launching your next attack.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p]

newsitems.title: The International 2026 Grand Champions
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/bab4343d906943ef2117ae553347d8f8991ebca3.png"][/img]Congratulations to Team Spirit, Grand Champions at The International 2026. After enduring a challenging year, Team Spirit regained their ultimate form just in time to take a five-game Grand Finals slugfest and claim the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai.[/p][p]Spirit's Group Stage started strong, with 2-0 victories over both Xtreme Gaming and Aurora Gaming. They followed with 2-1 win over Team Liquid that put Spirit just one series win away from qualifying for the main stage. They wouldn't get it. Instead, they served as a stepping stone. First to Team Vision, who dropped Spirit in just two games to secure their own invite to the arena. Next, Nigma Galaxy followed suit, handing Spirit another 0-2 loss to snatch a spot on the main stage and force Spirit into elimination play.[/p][p]Their elimination-round opponent? A scrappy Team Resilience who, despite their lower spot in the standings, had clawed out at least one victory in every series they'd played. This round would be no different. Team Spirit took game one with ease, but Resilience rebounded to force a win-or-go-home game three. There, Team Resilience managed to keep pace for a while, until Spirit pulled away in the back half of the match to secure their spot at The International Main Event.[/p][p]The first obstacle at the arena would be the dangerous Iron Wing -- who'd already taken Group Stage series wins off three teams who'd reached the main stage. It wouldn't matter. Team Spirit clipped Iron Wing to send them spiraling into the Lower Bracket and eventual elimination.[/p][p]The next series wouldn't net Spirit the same results. Team Vision, the foe that had already denied them an easy path to the Playoffs, was waiting for them once more. And the result was mostly the same -- Spirit lost. This time 1-2. This time falling into the Lower Bracket, where Team Liquid was already waiting after eliminating last year's champions. Liquid had a stellar showing in the groups, dropping only one series. But that loss came to this same Team Spirit squad they were again facing, and now Team Spirit wouldn't concede even one game.[/p][p]Spirit flushed Liquid out of the tournament to begin an undefeated run through the Lower Bracket, next bouncing both BoomBoys and Team Yandex with 2-0 statements to reach the Grand Finals against -- who else -- Team Vision, the front-runners that had been blocking Spirit's path every step of the way. The team that had stopped Spirit from skipping the elimination round. That had dropped them into the Lower Bracket to fight for their lives. The team that hadn't lost a single series in Shanghai... was now the one thing standing between Team Spirit and the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Game one was Team Spirit all the way. They looked to be cruising to victory in game two as well, but Vision had other plans, clawing back to even the series at one game apiece. It seemed that Vision might steal the momentum by snatching game three, but Spirit held firm to retake the series lead 2-1, just one win away from the Aegis. Once again, Vision would deny them. Their steady play in game four left no room for doubt -- this series was bound for a winner-take-all game five. And it didn't disappoint.[/p][p]After an hour-long showdown that was still anyone's game until the very end, Team Spirit finally overcame the team that had tormented them throughout the tournament, claiming the Aegis of Champions and crowning themselves the very best Dota team in the world. Three-time winners Yatoro and Collapse, and two-time winner Larl now welcome their teammates not_me and rue into an immortal pantheon.[/p][p]As bearers of the ultimate symbol of victory, these names shall forever be inscribed upon the Aegis of Champions:[/p][p][/p][p][b]2026 - Team Spirit[/b][/p][list][*][p]Illia "Yatoro" Muliarchuk[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Denis "Larl" Sigitov[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Magomed "Collapse" Khalilov[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Alexey "not_me" Kosmynin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Alexander "rue" Filin[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/55481652342_4378ab4bed_6k.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Until Next Time[/h3][p]If you missed any of the broadcast, or just want to rewatch some of the iconic plays, head over to the [url="https://www.youtube.com/user/dota2"]Dota 2 YouTube channel[/url], where you'll find replays of the entire show. You can also find a collection of photos from the event over on the [url="https://www.instagram.com/dota2/"]Dota 2 Instagram[/url] and even more hi-res shots on our [url="https://www.flickr.com/photos/dota2ti/"]Dota 2 flickr[/url].  As always, we'd like to thank all of the players, talent, and everyone in the Dota community for helping bring this global celebration to life. We've been honored to once again help shepherd this event to the stage, but it wouldn't be what it is without all of you.[/p]

newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/a7ab9b6d4c788583a689e0519021a93a76c17f30.png"][/img][/p][p]The sixteen best Dota teams in the world spent the last week battling through an intense Group Stage, and now only eight contenders remain. In a matter of hours Team Vision, Team Liquid, Nigma Galaxy, Team Falcons, BoomBoys, Team Spirit, Iron Wing, and Team Yandex will begin the final push to claim the Aegis of Champions as they all fight to be the last team standing at The International 2026.[/p][p]The double elimination bracket that will crown our champions kicks off at SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai on Thursday, August 20 and will culminate in a best-of-five Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23. We congratulate everyone who has made it this far, and we eagerly await the final test.[/p][p][/p][h2]Attending The International[/h2][p]If you're heading to the arena in Shanghai to watch The International live, a flurry of activity awaits you. Check out some of the more important details below.[/p][p][/p][h3]Schedule [/h3][p]The International pre-show begins each day at 9:30 AM China Standard Time. Things officially kick off with the Opening Ceremony at 10 AM on Thursday, and the first series is scheduled to start soon after. On the following days, matches will begin at 10 AM. Take in the [url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]full schedule of matches available here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]Meet the Teams[/h3][p]Each day of the Main Event, fans will have the chance to attend meet and greets with teams and talent on the 2F Concourse of the arena. Fan participation will be determined by a random draw of eligible ticket holders who have purchased tickets prior to 5 PM the day before. Selected fans will be notified electronically — as well as on TV displays throughout the venue concourse. More information on slots and eligibility will be provided on site.[/p][p][/p][h3]Crimson Witness and Badge Binding[/h3][p]Attendees should pick up their commemorative badges and event swag bags when they scan a digital ticket for their first entry into the venue. Remember to bind your badge to your Steam account to ensure you're eligible for Crimson Witness Treasure drops on the First Blood of each game at The International.[/p][p][/p][h3]Venue Information[/h3][p]To help things run smoothly, here's a rundown of some venue details you should know:[/p][list][*][p][b]What time do doors open? [/b]Arena doors open every day at 8 AM China Standard Time, two hours before the first match. Please note that entry will not be allowed after 9 PM each evening.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Where should I enter the arena?[/b] [url="https://cdn.steamstatic.com/apps/dota2/images/dota_react//international2026/map.png"]Please queue for entrance at the arena's Gate 0 Plaza[/url]. Those with 1F Stands and Suites tickets, please queue at the left-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. Those with 3F Stands tickets, please queue at the right-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. After passing through the turnstile for ticket verification, please collect your swag bag.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Can I sit anywhere or are there preassigned seats?[/b] Seats at The International 2026 are assigned. Please make sure to queue in the entry area designated outside of the arena for your seating sections.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Is re-entry permitted?[/b] All ticket holders are permitted to enter and exit the venue up to THREE times per match day. For re-entry, please re-queue in the designated lane.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The On-Site Secret Shop[/h3][p]The Secret Shop will operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from on-site cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]On-Site Activities[/h3][p]In addition to SecretLab and SteelSeries booths in the concourse, The International Players Jackets and Championship rings from all previous years will be on display. Plus, all fans are invited to leave their mark on the event by signing one of the graffiti walls. There will also be opportunities to take photos with cosplayers roaming the arena on Saturday and Sunday, and don't forget to check out the handmade embroidered Aegis of Champions on display throughout the event.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cosplay Finalists[/h3][p]Don't miss the best of this year's crop of Dota 2 cosplay, on display in the arena on August 23 before the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3]Watching The International Online[/h3][p]Even if you can't make it to the arena, there are still a ton of options to catch all the action at The International. From Twitch to YouTube to Steam, The International will be streamed on multiple platforms in multiple languages.[/p][list][*][p][b]Chinese[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]English[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Russian[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Spanish[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]Facebook[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Online Secret Shop[/h3][p]Fans interested in purchasing swag from this year's offerings are welcome to purchase online. We have two shops available, depending on which part of the world you're in. Fans located in China can purchase through [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] and fans everywhere else can head over to [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url] to check it all out.[/p]

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/aa83bcaaafe7cd4d11a841ec381ec28ccb039d41.png"][/img]It's the final countdown: Players and talent have landed, and all of the pieces are falling into place to make Shanghai the center of the Dota universe for the next two weeks. It's time to finish crafting your fantasy rosters, lock in your first round of predictions, and get ready to tune in because The International 2026 is almost underway.[/p][p]Whether you're looking to watch online, find Dota activities in Shanghai to keep you busy until streams start, or looking for merch you can wear while you're out in Shanghai waiting for games to start, we've got you covered below.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Group Stage[/h3][p]Sixteen teams have earned the right to compete for the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai, but only eight will face off in the main event. First, they must survive the gauntlet of the Swiss Format Group Stage.[/p][p][url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]Group Stage games begin[/url] on Thursday, August 13 and wrap on Sunday, August 16. In that span, all sixteen teams will play best-of-three matches against other teams with the same overall series record. A fourth series win will earn a team an automatic berth at The International; a fourth loss will result in elimination.[/p][p]By end of play on Saturday, three teams will have secured spots in The International and three teams will have been eliminated. The ten remaining teams will face off in a special elimination round to decide the rest. Every single one of the five series on Sunday will send one team home and the other onward to the main event.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Main Event[/h3][p]On Thursday, August 20, The International will move to SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center and open the doors to more than ten thousand fans. Four days of intense play through a double-elimination bracket will culminate in the Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23, and only then will the last team stand victorious and raise the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Tickets for the event are sold out, but there are tons of ways to watch online — and even a handful of special in-person opportunities available around the city of Shanghai.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tournament Streams[/h3][p]There's nothing quite like watching the best Dota players in the world face off in a live event, and while life and accompanying biological imperatives can make it difficult to try and watch every single game live, here are all the links you'd need to make a glorious attempt.[/p][p][/p][p]Chinese: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]English: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Russian: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Spanish: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url]; Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Dota 2 Heroes Around Shanghai[/h3][p]From August 13 to August 18, multiple Dota heroes will descend upon iconic landmarks across Shanghai, with a giant Aegis of Champions making its grand debut. Meanwhile, several commercial districts have set up check-in spots for fans to visit and collect souvenirs.[/p][p]Check out the landmark details below or visit [url="https://act.dota2.com.cn/2026/shanghaitour"]Perfect World's Shanghai Dota Tour site[/url] for a handy map.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dota Hero Landmark Locations[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Wujiaochang Commercial District[/p][/*][*][p]Wujiaochang Guangchang: Aegis of Champions[/p][/*][*][p]Bailian ZX Fun Mall: Queen of Pain, Axe, and Pudge[/p][/*][*][p]Shanghai Wujiaochang Wanda Plaza: Juggernaut[/p][/*][*][p]Lujiazui Super Brand Mall (Aug 12-18): Windranger[/p][/*][*][p]Shanghai EXPO Culture Park (Aug 13-18): Mars and Shadow Fiend[/p][/*][*][p]Taikoo Li Qiantan (Aug 18–24): Aegis of Champions, Drow Ranger, Crystal Maiden, and Juggernaut[/p][/*][*][p]Standard Check-in Spots: Lujiazui 96 Plaza, New bund 31, Shanghai No. 1 Shopping Center, Expo Place[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Secret Shops[/h3][p]If you're looking to scope out this year's merchandise offerings, our partner stores are already online for both Chinese and international customers.[/p][list][*][p]For China domestic fans: [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]For fans everywhere else: [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]The Secret Shop will also operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last match series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from onsite cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]Community Streams[/h3][p]The strength of Dota has always been its vibrant and passionate community. The International is an expression of that, both the in-person event and the many millions who participate online, those watching and those streaming.[/p][p]Speaking of which: As always, we welcome community streams of the event. There's more detail in [url="https://www.dota2.com/dotatv"]the community stream FAQ[/url], but to summarize: You have a lot of freedom in how to stream your TI commentary the way you and your viewers want as long as your stream is based on DotaTV and your own content, not on someone else's stream (including ours).[/p][p][/p][h3]Wrapping Up[/h3][p]There's obviously a lot going on already, but there's even more info about The International to come. We'll be back soon to provide more details about on-site events, badges, Crimson Witness drops and more as we move closer to the show. Until then, make sure to get those predictions in. We'll see you when groups start.[/p]
